ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited is acquiring Perion Network Limited for approximately $420 million in an all-cash transaction, significantly expanding its AI-powered consumer conversion business into developed markets and omnichannel advertising channels like Retail Media and CTV. This strategic move aims for a combined FY2028 revenue run rate exceeding $700 million and expects EPS accretion within the first year, though the planned post-acquisition transformation of Perion's revenue recognition and business model introduces operational and accounting change management.
